introduction:
Introduction About BON DK 60K CAPSULE

BON DK 60K CAPSULE contains Cholecalciferol which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamin D analogs. It is a form of vitamin D used in the management of vitamin D deficiency conditions and for certain bone conditions such as thinning of the bone (osteoporosis) which will be given to you with other medicines.

Deficiency of vitamin D may occur when your diet or lifestyle does not provide you with enough vitamin D or when your body requires more vitamin D (for instance when you are pregnant).

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to eat and drink foods that are rich in calcium. Your doctor might want to take certain blood tests prior to the management to understand the existing condition.

BON DK 60K CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have high levels of calcium in your blood (hypercalcaemia) or urine (hypercalciuria), are suffering from liver problems, kidney failure, kidney stones or have a tendency to form kidney stones, high levels of vitamin D in blood (hypervitaminosis).

Before taking BON DK 60K CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have any kind of heart disease or narrowing of the arteries, sarcoidosis (a multisystem chronic inflammatory condition which can affect your lungs, heart and kidneys) or if you are taking any medicines or food containing vitamin D. 

BON DK 60K CAPSULE should be used with caution among women who are pregnant and breastfeeding because too much vitamin D may harm your baby. BON DK 60K CAPSULE can only be given to children and adolescents aged 12 and above. Consult your doctor if you experience any unusual side effects during management with this medicine.

usesDetails:
Uses Of BON DK 60K CAPSULE
Corrects vitamin D deficiency

mechanismOfAction:
How BON DK 60K CAPSULE Works

BON DK 60K CAPSULE contains vitamin D which gets absorbed in the intestine and converted in the liver and kidneys to its active form. This active form helps the body absorb calcium and phosphate from the intestine, retain calcium in the kidneys, and release calcium from bones. It also supports the immune system by affecting immune cells and reducing inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use BON DK 60K CAPSULE

Take BON DK 60K CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

For Tablets, Capsules and softgels: Swallow BON DK 60K CAPSULE with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Orally Disintegrating tablet/strips and chewable tablet: Place the medicine beneath the tongue and allow it to dissolve on its own.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking BON DK 60K CAPSULE, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. carbamazepine, phenobarbital, phenytoin, primidone)
Other vitamin D containing medicines including multi-vitamins
 Medicines to control the rate of your heartbeat (Ex. digoxin, digitoxin)
 Diuretics (water tablets) (Ex. Bendroflumethiazide)
Calcium supplements
Medicines used to manage tuberculosis (Ex. rifampicin, isoniazid)
Medicines leading to fat malabsorption (Ex. orlistat, cholestyramine, liquid paraffin)
Medicines used to manage fungal infections (Ex. ketoconazole, itraconazole)
Actinomycin (medicine used to manage some forms of cancer)
Glucocorticosteroids Ex. hydrocortisone or prednisolone (used to manage inflammatory conditions)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of BON DK 60K CAPSULE, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Signs of overdose include loss of appetite, thirst, nausea, vomiting, constipation, abdominal pain, muscle weakness, tiredness, confusion, having to pass more urine than usual, bone pain, kidney problems and in severe cases it may cause irregular heartbeat, coma or even death.

name: BON DK Shot 60000IU Sugar Free Oral Solution 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About BON DK SHOT 60000IU ORAL SOLUTION

Bon DK Shot is a dietary supplement used to manage vitamin D deficiency, and as adjunct to specific management for osteoporosis (weak and brittle bones) in patients with vitamin D shortage or at risk of vitamin D insufficiency. It contains Cholecalciferol (Vitamin D3) as an active ingredient that helps to manage low levels of vitamin D in blood.

Cholecalciferol is mainly responsible for the maintenance of normal levels of phosphorus and serum calcium in the blood by enhancing the efficiency of the small intestine to absorb these minerals from the diet. It also stimulates the processes and increases calcium reabsorption from the kidneys.

Always take Bon DK Shot as advised by the physician. Shake well before use. Take Bon DK Shot once a week for a period of 8 weeks, or as directed by your doctor.

Bon DK Shot is not recommended for pregnant women without vitamin D deficiency. It can used in breastfeeding women while considering any additional vitamin D being given to the child.

Bon DK Shot should not be taken if you have high calcium or vitamin D levels in your blood. Bon DK Shot should be used with caution if you have sarcoidosis (growth of tiny groups of inflammatory cells in different parts of the body), kidney impairment or any heart disease.

name: Ultra D3 800IU Drops 15ml
introduction:
Introduction About ULTRA D3 800IU DROPS

Ultra-D3 800 Drops is a dietary supplement used to manage vitamin D deficiency in children and adolescents. It is also used as an adjunct to bone loss medicines. It contains Cholecalciferol (vitamin D3) as an active ingredient which helps manage low vitamin D3 levels in the blood.

Cholecalciferol helps maintain the normal blood levels of calcium and phosphorus by boosting the small intestine's ability to absorb these nutrients from food. In children, vitamin D is essential for the growth and development of bones, and it also contributes to the normal functioning of the immune system and in maintaining healthy teeth.

Always take Ultra-D3 800 Drops as advised by the physician. Shake well before use. It is advised to take 1 drop of Ultra-D3 800 Drops per day or as directed by your physician.

Do not use Ultra-D3 800 Drops if you have malabsorption syndrome, increased levels of calcium or vitamin D3 in blood, or excess calcium in the urine. Inform your doctor if you have any kidney or immune system disorders.

name: Metabolis Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About METABOLIS TABLET

Metabolis Tablet is a dietary supplement used to manage metabolic disorders. It is used as a dietary supplement in conditions such as obesity, hypertension, dyslipidemia, and insulin resistance. It is also used to fulfil the increased nutritional demands in conditions including type II diabetes, heart problem, borderline diabetes, and hypertension with lifestyle modifications. It contains Alpha lipoic acid, Calcium pantothenate, Elemental chromium, Elemental magnesium, Elemental manganese, Folic acid, Niacinamide, Riboflavin, and Ubidecarenone as active ingredients that help in minimizing the oxidative stress.

Antioxidants help in lowering the oxidative stress by neutralizing the unstable free radicals in the body which are responsible for causing inflammation in the body. Multimineral helps in optimizing the metabolism of the body. B vitamins including folic acid, niacinamide (vit b3), and riboflavin act as co-factors in running numerous metabolic reactions in the body and maintaining the overall body health.

Metabolis Tablet can be taken at any time in a day or as directed by healthcare professional. It should be swallowed whole with an adequate amount of water or taken as directed by the physician. Do not take if you are allergic to any of its ingredients. It is not for medicinal use.

introduction:
Introduction About RIO D3 400IU ORAL SOLUTION

RIO D3 Oral Solution is a vitamin supplement used in the management of vitamin D deficiency, rickets, hypocalcemia (low blood calcium levels), and fractures. It contains vitamin D3 as an active ingredient.

Vitamin D3 aids in the absorption of calcium and phosphorus from the intestine and helps to build strong bones.

Always give RIO D3 Oral Solution to your child as advised by your doctor. Shake well before use. Do not exceed the recommended dosage. Inform your doctor if your child has any pre-existing diseases before giving RIO D3 Oral Solution.

Introduction About MACBRITE D3 800IU DROPS

Macbrite D3 800IU Drops is a Vitamin D Supplement used in children to improve bone health. It contains Cholecalciferol (Vitamin D3) as active ingredient which helps to restore vitamin D levels in the body.

Cholecalciferol, a bio-active form of Vitamin D. It is essential for the formation of healthy bones and teeth and for proper absorption of bone minerals like calcium, magnesium and phosphate taken either through diet or supplementation.

Administer Macbrite D3 800IU Drops to your child as directed by your physician. Shake the medicine well before use. Measure the required amount of the medicine in the measuring dropper provided with the pack. Make sure to rinse the measuring dropper in warm water before and after use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for your child, based on their age and body weight.

name: Vitanova D3 Granules 1gm
introduction:
Introduction About VITANOVA D3 GRANULES

VITANOVA D3 GRANULES contains Cholecalciferol which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamin D analogs. It is a form of vitamin D used in the management of vitamin D deficiency conditions and for certain bone conditions such as thinning of the bone (osteoporosis) which will be given to you with other medicines.

Deficiency of vitamin D may occur when your diet or lifestyle does not provide you with enough vitamin D or when your body requires more vitamin D (for instance when you are pregnant).

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to eat and drink foods that are rich in calcium. Your doctor might want to take certain blood tests prior to the management to understand the existing condition.

VITANOVA D3 GRANULES is not recommended for use if you have high levels of calcium in your blood (hypercalcaemia) or urine (hypercalciuria), are suffering from liver problems, kidney failure, kidney stones or have a tendency to form kidney stones, high levels of vitamin D in blood (hypervitaminosis).

Before taking VITANOVA D3 GRANULES, inform your doctor if you have any kind of heart disease or narrowing of the arteries, sarcoidosis (a multisystem chronic inflammatory condition which can affect your lungs, heart and kidneys) or if you are taking any medicines or food containing vitamin D. 

VITANOVA D3 GRANULES should be used with caution among women who are pregnant and breastfeeding because too much vitamin D may harm your baby. VITANOVA D3 GRANULES can only be given to children and adolescents aged 12 and above. Consult your doctor if you experience any unusual side effects during management with this medicine.

mechanismOfAction:
How VITANOVA D3 GRANULES Works

VITANOVA D3 GRANULES contains vitamin D which gets absorbed in the intestine and converted in the liver and kidneys to its active form. This active form helps the body absorb calcium and phosphate from the intestine, retain calcium in the kidneys, and release calcium from bones. It also supports the immune system by affecting immune cells and reducing inflammation.
usageDetails:

Take VITANOVA D3 GRANULES as advised by your physician. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

For Tablets, Capsules and softgels: Swallow VITANOVA D3 GRANULES with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Orally Disintegrating tablet/strips and chewable tablet: Place the medicine beneath the tongue and allow it to dissolve on its own.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking VITANOVA D3 GRANULES, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. carbamazepine, phenobarbital, phenytoin, primidone)
Other vitamin D containing medicines including multi-vitamins
 Medicines to control the rate of your heartbeat (Ex. digoxin, digitoxin)
 Diuretics (water tablets) (Ex. Bendroflumethiazide)
Calcium supplements
Medicines used to manage tuberculosis (Ex. rifampicin, isoniazid)
Medicines leading to fat malabsorption (Ex. orlistat, cholestyramine, liquid paraffin)
Medicines used to manage fungal infections (Ex. ketoconazole, itraconazole)
Actinomycin (medicine used to manage some forms of cancer)
Glucocorticosteroids Ex. hydrocortisone or prednisolone (used to manage inflammatory conditions)

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of VITANOVA D3 GRANULES, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Signs of overdose include loss of appetite, thirst, nausea, vomiting, constipation, abdominal pain, muscle weakness, tiredness, confusion, having to pass more urine than usual, bone pain, kidney problems and in severe cases it may cause irregular heartbeat, coma or even death.

introduction:
Introduction About CALSHINE SG 60K CAPSULE

CALSHINE SG 60K CAPSULE contains Cholecalciferol which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamin D analogs. It is a form of vitamin D used in the management of vitamin D deficiency conditions and for certain bone conditions such as thinning of the bone (osteoporosis) which will be given to you with other medicines.

CALSHINE SG 60K CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have high levels of calcium in your blood (hypercalcaemia) or urine (hypercalciuria), are suffering from liver problems, kidney failure, kidney stones or have a tendency to form kidney stones, high levels of vitamin D in blood (hypervitaminosis).

Before taking CALSHINE SG 60K CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have any kind of heart disease or narrowing of the arteries, sarcoidosis (a multisystem chronic inflammatory condition which can affect your lungs, heart and kidneys) or if you are taking any medicines or food containing vitamin D. 

CALSHINE SG 60K CAPSULE should be used with caution among women who are pregnant and breastfeeding because too much vitamin D may harm your baby. How CALSHINE SG 60K CAPSULE Works

CALSHINE SG 60K CAPSULE contains vitamin D which gets absorbed in the intestine and converted in the liver and kidneys to its active form. Introduction About TALIA D3 DROPS

Talia D3 Drops is a nutritional supplement used for the management of vitamin D deficiency in children. It contains Vitamin D3 (cholecalciferol) as an active ingredient that helps to manage low levels of vitamin D in blood.

Vitamin D3 helps the body to absorb calcium and phosphorus that are essential for the production and maintenance of stronger and healthier bones. It helps to maintain normal levels of Vitamin D3 needed for the body.

Always take Talia D3 Drops exactly as advised by your child’s doctor. Shake well before use. It is advised to take 1ml of Talia D3 Drops per day or as directed by your physician. Pull out the teat of the dropper sightly for administration of the drops.

Do not exceed the daily recommended doses. Do not give Talia D3 Drops to your child if he/she has malabsorption syndrome, increased levels of calcium, vitamin D3 or phosphate in blood, or any kidney diseases.

introduction:
Introduction About GLUTANASE TABLET

Glutanase Tablet is a dietary supplement used to meet up the nutritional requirements in the body. It contains L-glutathione, vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants as active ingredients that helps in the normal growth and functioning of the body.

Body uses amino acids like glutathione to make proteins that help for growth, breakdown of food, and repair body tissues. Vitamin A is a crucial nutrient for eyesight, immunity, and reproduction. Vitamin C helps in maintaining the structure of cartilages, bones and teeth. Vitamin E acts as an antioxidant and helps maintain the integrity of the blood vessels.

Manganese and zinc are involved in the formation and degradation of carbohydrates, lipids, proteins, and nucleic acids. Zinc is important for normal growth, wound healing, and sexual maturation. Selenium helps to produce DNA and protect against cell damage and infections.

Always take Glutanase Tablet as advised by your physician. Do not exceed the recommended dosage. Ask your doctor before taking it during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Inform your doctor if you have liver, stomach or bowel problems (Ex. ulcer, colitis), or if you use or abuse alcohol.

introduction:
Introduction About D SOL 60K TABLET

D SOL 60K TABLET contains Cholecalciferol which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamin D analogs. It is a form of vitamin D used in the management of vitamin D deficiency conditions and for certain bone conditions such as thinning of the bone (osteoporosis) which will be given to you with other medicines.

Deficiency of vitamin D may occur when your diet or lifestyle does not provide you with enough vitamin D or when your body requires more vitamin D (for instance when you are pregnant).

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to eat and drink foods that are rich in calcium. Your doctor might want to take certain blood tests prior to the management to understand the existing condition.

D SOL 60K TABLET is not recommended for use if you have high levels of calcium in your blood (hypercalcaemia) or urine (hypercalciuria), are suffering from liver problems, kidney failure, kidney stones or have a tendency to form kidney stones, high levels of vitamin D in blood (hypervitaminosis).

Before taking D SOL 60K TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any kind of heart disease or narrowing of the arteries, sarcoidosis (a multisystem chronic inflammatory condition which can affect your lungs, heart and kidneys) or if you are taking any medicines or food containing vitamin D. 

D SOL 60K TABLET should be used with caution among women who are pregnant and breastfeeding because too much vitamin D may harm your baby. D SOL 60K TABLET can only be given to children and adolescents aged 12 and above. Consult your doctor if you experience any unusual side effects during management with this medicine.

name: RADCAL 500 Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About RADCAL 500 TABLET

RADCAL 500 TABLET contains Calcium carbonate and Vitamin D3 (cholecalciferol) which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium supplements and Vitamin derivatives respectively. It is used to manage calcium deficiency (low levels of calcium in blood).

Low levels of calcium are associated with poor dietary intake of calcium, mainly seen during pregnancy and lactation. RADCAL 500 TABLET is also used for the management of osteoporosis (bones become brittle and fragile), osteomalacia (softening of bones), rickets (abnormal calcification, softening and distortion of the bones typically resulting in bowlegs) and hypoparathyroidism (low levels of parathyroid hormones).

Patients undergoing management with RADCAL 500 TABLET will be asked to monitor their plasma levels of calcium frequently to avoid hypercalcemia (increased calcium levels).

RADCAL 500 TABLET can be used during pregnancy and breast-feeding only if advised by the doctor. However, consult your doctor before taking to understand required dosages that helps to manage hypercalcemia and reduce the harm of the baby.

RADCAL 500 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with hypervitaminosis D (increased levels of vitamin D in blood), kidney stones, diseases that increases calcium levels in blood and urine (Ex. hyperparathyroidism).

RADCAL 500 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with sarcoidosis (growth of tiny collection of inflammatory cells or granulomas in any part of the body), immobilised patients with osteoporosis (brittle bones), malignancies (abnormal growth of cells) and impaired renal function.   

The most common side effects of taking RADCAL 500 TABLET includes nausea, vomiting, constipation, excess gas, dry mouth, loss of hunger and acid refluxes. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Immobilised patients with osteoporosis (brittle bones)
Malignancies (abnormal growth of cells)

RADCAL 500 TABLET should be used with caution in children. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

RADCAL 500 TABLET should be taken with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking RADCAL 500 TABLET.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking RADCAL 500 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Thiazide diuretics (medicines used to manage high blood pressure. Ex. chlorothiazide, hydrochlorothiazide)
Corticosteroids (medicine used to manage inflammations in various parts of the body Ex. prednisolone, methylprednisolone, betamethasone)
Cholestyramine (used to manage high cholesterol levels)
Laxatives such as paraffin oil (medicine used to manage constipation)
Tetracyclines (used to manage bacterial infections)
Cardiac glycosides such as digoxin, digitoxin (medicines used to manage heart diseases)
Bisphosphonate or sodium fluoride (medicine used to manage bone diseases)
Levothyroxine (medicine used to manage thyroid diseases)
Quinolone antibiotics (medicines used to manage bacterial infection. Ex. ciprofloxacin, levofloxacin)

Rifampicin (medicine used to manage tuberculosis)
Phenytoin and barbiturates such as phenobarbital (medicine used to manage fits)
Iron, zinc or strontium supplements

Avoid taking RADCAL 500 TABLET along with oxalic and phytic acid-rich foods like spinach, bran, whole cereals, etc. Do not take within two hours of eating foods high in oxalic acid and phytic acid.

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of RADCAL 500 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. introduction:
Introduction About CALCIGEN D3 60KIU CAPSULE

CALCIGEN D3 60KIU CAPSULE contains Cholecalciferol which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamin D analogs. It is a form of vitamin D used in the management of vitamin D deficiency conditions and for certain bone conditions such as thinning of the bone (osteoporosis) which will be given to you with other medicines.

Deficiency of vitamin D may occur when your diet or lifestyle does not provide you with enough vitamin D or when your body requires more vitamin D (for instance when you are pregnant).

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to eat and drink foods that are rich in calcium. Your doctor might want to take certain blood tests prior to the management to understand the existing condition.

CALCIGEN D3 60KIU CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have high levels of calcium in your blood (hypercalcaemia) or urine (hypercalciuria), are suffering from liver problems, kidney failure, kidney stones or have a tendency to form kidney stones, high levels of vitamin D in blood (hypervitaminosis).

Before taking CALCIGEN D3 60KIU CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have any kind of heart disease or narrowing of the arteries, sarcoidosis (a multisystem chronic inflammatory condition which can affect your lungs, heart and kidneys) or if you are taking any medicines or food containing vitamin D. 

CALCIGEN D3 60KIU CAPSULE should be used with caution among women who are pregnant and breastfeeding because too much vitamin D may harm your baby. CALCIGEN D3 60KIU CAPSULE can only be given to children and adolescents aged 12 and above. Consult your doctor if you experience any unusual side effects during management with this medicine.

mechanismOfAction:
How CALCIGEN D3 60KIU CAPSULE Works

CALCIGEN D3 60KIU CAPSULE contains vitamin D which gets absorbed in the intestine and converted in the liver and kidneys to its active form. This active form helps the body absorb calcium and phosphate from the intestine, retain calcium in the kidneys, and release calcium from bones. It also supports the immune system by affecting immune cells and reducing inflammation.

Take CALCIGEN D3 60KIU CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

For Tablets, Capsules and softgels: Swallow CALCIGEN D3 60KIU CAPSULE with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Orally Disintegrating tablet/strips and chewable tablet: Place the medicine beneath the tongue and allow it to dissolve on its own.

Introduction About CALDISON D3 60000IU POWDER

Caldison D3 Sachet is a nutritional supplement used to manage vitamin D deficiency. It contains Vitamin D3 (cholecalciferol) as an active ingredient that helps to manage low levels of vitamin D in blood.

Always take Caldison D3 Sachet exactly as advised by your doctor. Dissolve the contents of Caldison D3 Sachet in milk or use as directed by the physician. Do not exceed the daily recommended dose.

Do not take Caldison D3 Sachet if you have malabsorption syndrome, increased levels of calcium, vitamin D3 or phosphate levels in blood, or any kidney diseases. Ask your doctor before taking it during pregnancy or breastfeeding, as the dose might need to be adjusted accordingly.

introduction:
Introduction About DR EXCELD3 CAPSULE

DR EXCELD3 CAPSULE contains Cholecalciferol which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamin D analogs. It is a form of vitamin D used in the management of vitamin D deficiency conditions and for certain bone conditions such as thinning of the bone (osteoporosis) which will be given to you with other medicines.

Deficiency of vitamin D may occur when your diet or lifestyle does not provide you with enough vitamin D or when your body requires more vitamin D (for instance when you are pregnant).

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to eat and drink foods that are rich in calcium. Your doctor might want to take certain blood tests prior to the management to understand the existing condition.

DR EXCELD3 CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have high levels of calcium in your blood (hypercalcaemia) or urine (hypercalciuria), are suffering from liver problems, kidney failure, kidney stones or have a tendency to form kidney stones, high levels of vitamin D in blood (hypervitaminosis).

Before taking DR EXCELD3 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have any kind of heart disease or narrowing of the arteries, sarcoidosis (a multisystem chronic inflammatory condition which can affect your lungs, heart and kidneys) or if you are taking any medicines or food containing vitamin D. 

DR EXCELD3 CAPSULE should be used with caution among women who are pregnant and breastfeeding because too much vitamin D may harm your baby. DR EXCELD3 CAPSULE can only be given to children and adolescents aged 12 and above. Consult your doctor if you experience any unusual side effects during management with this medicine.

mechanismOfAction:
How DR EXCELD3 CAPSULE Works

DR EXCELD3 CAPSULE contains vitamin D which gets absorbed in the intestine and converted in the liver and kidneys to its active form. This active form helps the body absorb calcium and phosphate from the intestine, retain calcium in the kidneys, and release calcium from bones. It also supports the immune system by affecting immune cells and reducing inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use DR EXCELD3 CAPSULE

Take DR EXCELD3 CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

For Tablets, Capsules and softgels: Swallow DR EXCELD3 CAPSULE with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Orally Disintegrating tablet/strips and chewable tablet: Place the medicine beneath the tongue and allow it to dissolve on its own.

Introduction About WALCIUM D3 GRANULES

WALCIUM D3 GRANULES contains Cholecalciferol (Vitamin D3) which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamin D analogue. It is used to manage Vitamin D deficiency. This may occur when your diet or lifestyle does not provide you with enough vitamin D or when your body requires more vitamin D during pregnancy.

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to eat and drink foods rich in calcium. Your doctor might want to take certain blood tests prior to the management to understand the existing condition.

WALCIUM D3 GRANULES is not recommended for use if you have high levels of calcium in the blood, malabsorption syndrome, hypervitaminosis D, renal osteodystrophy (kidney disease weakening the bones) with hyperphosphataemia.

Before taking WALCIUM D3 GRANULES, inform your doctor if you have impaired kidney or liver function, are immobilized due to osteoporosis, sarcoidosis (a multisystem chronic inflammatory condition which can affect your lungs, heart and kidneys) and hyperlipidemia (high lipid levels).

WALCIUM D3 GRANULES should be used with caution in pregnant or breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and elderly patients. Consult your doctor immediately if you experience any unusual effects during management with this medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About D3 TOTAL CHEW TABLET

D3 TOTAL CHEW TABLET contains Cholecalciferol which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamin D analogs. It is a form of vitamin D used in the management of vitamin D deficiency conditions and for certain bone conditions such as thinning of the bone (osteoporosis) which will be given to you with other medicines.

Deficiency of vitamin D may occur when your diet or lifestyle does not provide you with enough vitamin D or when your body requires more vitamin D (for instance when you are pregnant).

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to eat and drink foods that are rich in calcium. Your doctor might want to take certain blood tests prior to the management to understand the existing condition.

D3 TOTAL CHEW TABLET is not recommended for use if you have high levels of calcium in your blood (hypercalcaemia) or urine (hypercalciuria), are suffering from liver problems, kidney failure, kidney stones or have a tendency to form kidney stones, high levels of vitamin D in blood (hypervitaminosis).

Before taking D3 TOTAL CHEW TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any kind of heart disease or narrowing of the arteries, sarcoidosis (a multisystem chronic inflammatory condition which can affect your lungs, heart and kidneys) or if you are taking any medicines or food containing vitamin D. 

D3 TOTAL CHEW TABLET should be used with caution among women who are pregnant and breastfeeding because too much vitamin D may harm your baby. D3 TOTAL CHEW TABLET can only be given to children and adolescents aged 12 and above. Consult your doctor if you experience any unusual side effects during management with this medicine.

mechanismOfAction:
How D3 TOTAL CHEW TABLET Works

D3 TOTAL CHEW TABLET contains vitamin D which gets absorbed in the intestine and converted in the liver and kidneys to its active form. This active form helps the body absorb calcium and phosphate from the intestine, retain calcium in the kidneys, and release calcium from bones. It also supports the immune system by affecting immune cells and reducing inflammation.

For Tablets, Capsules and softgels: Swallow D3 TOTAL CHEW TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Orally Disintegrating tablet/strips and chewable tablet: Place the medicine beneath the tongue and allow it to dissolve on its own.

Introduction About DV 60K CAPSULE

DV 60K CAPSULE is a Vitamin D3 supplement that helps in managing vitamin D deficiency, improving calcium absorption, and supporting bone health. It is commonly recommended for individuals with low vitamin D levels, osteoporosis, and other bone-related issues.

Take DV 60K CAPSULE as advised by your doctor. It is a single dose medicine which means at each dose, all the contents of one bottle should be consumed altogether. It is usually suggested to take once per week for managing vitamin D deficiency for 6-12 weeks followed by a low dose vitamin D as a maintenance therapy.

Before taking DV 60K CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have any kidney problems, liver problems or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. DV 60K CAPSULE is usually safe and well tolerated. However, it may cause nausea, dry mouth, constipation and metallic taste in mouth in some individuals which can be easily managed.

Do not take more than the recommended dose of this medicine. Since DV 60K CAPSULE is high dose (60,000 IU), taking more doses than prescribed may cause increased levels of vitamin D and calcium in blood causing unpleasant symptoms. If you missed a dose of DV 60K CAPSULE, simply skip the missed dose and take the next dose. Do not take a double dose to make the missed dose.

Introduction About OSSIROL D3 ORAL SOLUTION

OSSIROL D3 Oral Solution is a dietary supplement used to manage vitamin D deficiency, and as adjunct to specific management for osteoporosis (weak and brittle bones) in patients with vitamin D deficiency or at risk of vitamin D insufficiency. It contains Cholecalciferol (Vitamin D3) as an active ingredient which helps to manage low levels of vitamin D in the blood.

Cholecalciferol is mainly responsible for the maintenance of normal levels of phosphorus and serum calcium in the blood by enhancing the efficiency of the small intestine to absorb these minerals from the diet. It also stimulates the processes and increases calcium reabsorption from the kidneys. Always take OSSIROL D3 Oral Solution as advised by the physician. Shake well before use. Take OSSIROL D3 Oral Solution once a week for a period of 8 weeks, or as directed by your doctor.

OSSIROL D3 Oral Solution is not recommended for pregnant women without vitamin D deficiency. It can used in breastfeeding women while considering any additional vitamin D being given to the child. OSSIROL D3 Oral Solution should not be taken if you have high calcium or vitamin D levels in the blood. OSSIROL D3 Oral Solution should be used with caution if you have sarcoidosis (growth of tiny groups of inflammatory cells in different parts of the body), kidney impairment or any heart disease.

Introduction About DVION PEARL 60K CAPSULE

DVION PEARL 60K CAPSULE contains Cholecalciferol which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamin D analogs. It is a form of vitamin D used in the management of vitamin D deficiency conditions and for certain bone conditions such as thinning of the bone (osteoporosis) which will be given to you with other medicines.

Deficiency of vitamin D may occur when your diet or lifestyle does not provide you with enough vitamin D or when your body requires more vitamin D (for instance when you are pregnant).

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to eat and drink foods that are rich in calcium. Your doctor might want to take certain blood tests prior to the management to understand the existing condition.

DVION PEARL 60K CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have high levels of calcium in your blood (hypercalcaemia) or urine (hypercalciuria), are suffering from liver problems, kidney failure, kidney stones or have a tendency to form kidney stones, high levels of vitamin D in blood (hypervitaminosis).

Before taking DVION PEARL 60K CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have any kind of heart disease or narrowing of the arteries, sarcoidosis (a multisystem chronic inflammatory condition which can affect your lungs, heart and kidneys) or if you are taking any medicines or food containing vitamin D. 

DVION PEARL 60K CAPSULE should be used with caution among women who are pregnant and breastfeeding because too much vitamin D may harm your baby. DVION PEARL 60K CAPSULE can only be given to children and adolescents aged 12 and above. Consult your doctor if you experience any unusual side effects during management with this medicine.

ORRO D3 SOFT GELATIN CAPSULE contains Cholecalciferol which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamin D analogs. It is a form of vitamin D used in the management of vitamin D deficiency conditions and for certain bone conditions such as thinning of the bone (osteoporosis) which will be given to you with other medicines.

Introduction About GESTACAL TABLET

Gestacal Tablet is a calcium supplement which is used to keep the bones strong in osteoporosis and arthritis. It contains Calcium, DHA and Vitamin D3 as the active ingredients which maintain nutritional states in Calcium and Vitamin D deficiency.

Calcium is a dietary supplement used when the amount of calcium taken in the diet is not sufficient. Calcium is required by the body for healthy bones, muscles, nervous system, and heart. Vitamin D3 helps the body absorb calcium and strengthen bones and muscles, boosts immunity, increases mood and improves heart function. DHA reduces the risk of heart disease, strengthens muscles.

Take Gestacal Tablet as recommended by your doctor. Swallow Gestacal Tablet with a glass of water, do not crush, chew, or break the tablet. Do not exceed the recommended daily dosage of Gestacal Tablet. Inform your doctor if you have high levels of calcium in blood/urine, hyperactive thyroid, bone cancer, kidney, liver problems before taking Gestacal Tablet.

Corrects vitamin D deficiency
Manages osteoporosis (thinning of the bone) and other related bone conditions
mechanismOfAction:
How TROYVIT D3 CAPSULE Works

TROYVIT D3 CAPSULE contains vitamin D which gets absorbed in the intestine and converted in the liver and kidneys to its active form. This active form helps the body absorb calcium and phosphate from the intestine, retain calcium in the kidneys, and release calcium from bones. It also supports the immune system by affecting immune cells and reducing inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use TROYVIT D3 CAPSULE

Take TROYVIT D3 CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

For Tablets, Capsules and softgels: Swallow TROYVIT D3 CAPSULE with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Orally Disintegrating tablet/strips and chewable tablet: Place the medicine beneath the tongue and allow it to dissolve on its own.
sideEffects: Increased calcium in the blood (hypercalcaemia) (signs include nausea or vomiting, loss of appetite, constipation, stomachache, feel very thirsty, muscle weakness, drowsiness or confusion)
Swollen face, lips, tongue or throat
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of TROYVIT D3 CAPSULE
Uncommon
Increased calcium in the blood (hypercalcaemia) (signs include nausea or vomiting, loss of appetite, constipation, stomachache, feel very thirsty, muscle weakness, drowsiness or confusion)
Increased calcium in the urine (hypercalciuria)
Rare
Skin rash
Itching

Stop taking TROYVIT D3 CAPSULE and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Swollen face, lips, tongue or throat 
Difficult to swallow and breathe
Raised itchy rash (hives)

warnings.details: TROYVIT D3 CAPSULE should be used with caution in pregnant women or women planning to have a baby. Consult your doctor before taking it. If you require extra vitamin D do not take it without medical supervision because too much vitamin D may harm your baby.

TROYVIT D3 CAPSULE should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking it. If you require extra vitamin D do not take it without medical supervision because too much vitamin D may harm your baby.
TROYVIT D3 CAPSULE does not affect your ability to drive or use machines. Consult your doctor before taking it

TROYVIT D3 CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with kidney failure, kidney stones (renal calculi) or have a tendency to form kidney stones. Consult your doctor before taking TROYVIT D3 CAPSULE.
TROYVIT D3 CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. Dose will be adjusted by your doctor. Consult your doctor before taking TROYVIT D3 CAPSULE.
TROYVIT D3 CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Cholecalciferol or any other ingredients of this medicine.
TROYVIT D3 CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with heart disease or narrowing of the arteries. Consult your doctor before taking TROYVIT D3 CAPSULE.
TROYVIT D3 CAPSULE is recommended for children and adolescents aged 12 and above. Dose will be adjusted by your child’s doctor. Consult your child’s doctor before taking TROYVIT D3 CAPSULE.

Others

TROYVIT D3 CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you:

Have high levels of calcium in the blood (hypercalcaemia) or urine (hypercalciuria)
Have high levels of vitamin D in the blood (hypervitaminosis D)

Before taking TROYVIT D3 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you:

Have sarcoidosis (a multisystem chronic inflammatory condition which can affect your lungs, heart and kidneys)
Are taking medicines containing vitamin D or eating foods or drinking milk enriched with vitamin D

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking TROYVIT D3 CAPSULE, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. carbamazepine, phenobarbital, phenytoin, primidone)
Other vitamin D containing medicines including multi-vitamins
 Medicines to control the rate of your heartbeat (Ex. digoxin, digitoxin)
 Diuretics (water tablets) (Ex. Bendroflumethiazide)
Calcium supplements
Medicines used to manage tuberculosis (Ex. rifampicin, isoniazid)
Medicines leading to fat malabsorption (Ex. orlistat, cholestyramine, liquid paraffin)
Medicines used to manage fungal infections (Ex. ketoconazole, itraconazole)
Actinomycin (medicine used to manage some forms of cancer)
Glucocorticosteroids Ex. hydrocortisone or prednisolone (used to manage inflammatory conditions)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of TROYVIT D3 CAPSULE, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Signs of overdose include loss of appetite, thirst, nausea, vomiting, constipation, abdominal pain, muscle weakness, tiredness, confusion, having to pass more urine than usual, bone pain, kidney problems and in severe cases it may cause irregular heartbeat, coma or even death.

introduction:
Introduction About OBVIT D3 MD CHEWABLE TABLET

OBVIT D3 MD CHEWABLE TABLET contains Cholecalciferol which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamin D analogs. It is a form of vitamin D used in the management of vitamin D deficiency conditions and for certain bone conditions such as thinning of the bone (osteoporosis) which will be given to you with other medicines.

Deficiency of vitamin D may occur when your diet or lifestyle does not provide you with enough vitamin D or when your body requires more vitamin D (for instance when you are pregnant).

Along with this management, your doctor might advise you to eat and drink foods that are rich in calcium. Your doctor might want to take certain blood tests prior to the management to understand the existing condition.

OBVIT D3 MD CHEWABLE TABLET is not recommended for use if you have high levels of calcium in your blood (hypercalcaemia) or urine (hypercalciuria), are suffering from liver problems, kidney failure, kidney stones or have a tendency to form kidney stones, high levels of vitamin D in blood (hypervitaminosis).

Before taking OBVIT D3 MD CHEWABLE TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any kind of heart disease or narrowing of the arteries, sarcoidosis (a multisystem chronic inflammatory condition which can affect your lungs, heart and kidneys) or if you are taking any medicines or food containing vitamin D. 

OBVIT D3 MD CHEWABLE TABLET should be used with caution among women who are pregnant and breastfeeding because too much vitamin D may harm your baby. OBVIT D3 MD CHEWABLE TABLET can only be given to children and adolescents aged 12 and above. Consult your doctor if you experience any unusual side effects during management with this medicine.
